description.value: The White Rock Museum & Archives occupies a heritage train station right on the beach at Semiahmoo Bay, placing it squarely on Marine Drive — a scenic waterfront route popular with cyclists. It holds rotating exhibitions on local and First Nations history alongside a substantial archival collection spanning newspapers from 1940–1973. Admission is by donation, and guided walking tours of the beach, pier, and train station are offered by appointment.
